description: Set or remove DOCX document properties from a closed set: core (title, subject, creator, keywords, description, category, content_status, language, last_modified_by, revision, created, modified) and extended (application, app_version, company, manager, template). A string sets a property, null removes its element, and an omitted key is left unchanged. created and modified must be W3CDTF dates (e.g. 2026-01-02 or 2026-01-02T03:04:05Z) and are written with xsi:type="dcterms:W3CDTF"; revision is a non-negative integer; app_version has the form XX.YYYY. Only the named elements change: other elements, namespaces and extensions in the parts are kept. A document without docProps/core.xml or docProps/app.xml gets the part, its package relationship and its content-type override when a value is set in it. Surface: package-mutation — document properties have no tracked-change form, so an effective change is untracked and listed in the save report non-revision change manifest. A call whose values already hold reports changed=false and records no edit. DOCX only.

app_version.description: AppVersion, of the form XX.YYYY such as 16.0000.

application.description: Application: the name of the producing application; null leaves it out.

core.description: Core properties (docProps/core.xml). identifier, version and last_printed are read-only.

content_status.description: cp:contentStatus, such as Draft or Final.

keywords.description: cp:keywords; replaces any existing keyword values.

language.description: dc:language, a language tag such as en-US.

revision.description: cp:revision, a non-negative integer; null removes it.

file_path.description: Path to the DOCX or ODT file.

google_doc_id.description: Google Doc ID or URL (alternative to file_path). Extract from URL: docs.google.com/document/d/{ID}/edit

name: set_document_properties
